study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial (NiPPeR trial)
exposure: Combined myo-inositol, probiotics, and enriched micronutrient supplement (intervention)
cohort: The study included 583 women who participated in the NiPPeR trial, with exposure measurements taken preconception, in early pregnancy (~7 weeks), and late pregnancy (~28 weeks).
finding: A higher concentration of myo-inositol in early pregnancy was significantly associated with a reduction in postpartum blood loss, accounting for a substantial portion of the previously reported intervention effect.
followup_time: Immediately postpartum for blood loss measurements.
